text.tspan: Voice enrollment, consent and template storage
The current enrollment endpoint calls Teams. The internal speaker model scores audio; it never authorizes access.
Microsoft Azure
EntraGuard · verified logical flows
NUMBERED INTERACTIONS · time runs downward · dashed = response / conditional interaction (not every branch runs)
STEP DETAILS / DECISION RULES
Numbers match the interaction on the left.
User / settings
Enrollment API
ACS / Teams
Coordinator
Voiceprint model
Tables / audit
Start with explicit consent
01 POST enrollment/start with current consentVersion, the
signed-in Teams ID and explicit reenroll when replacing a
profile.
Check identity + MFA
02 Validate caller and same-owner MFA evidence when required
(default on). Reject a mismatched Teams target.
Check profile + encryption
03 Require available encrypted storage. An existing profile needs
explicit re-enrollment; no plaintext-template fallback exists.
Dial enrollment call
04 Choose three phrases and set IsVerificationCall. Configure
signed media/callback URLs and the user's participant role.
Connected / prompt played
05 Speak the phrase through ACS. After prompt completion, clear
the audio buffer to avoid including the spoken prompt.
Capture seven-second window
06 Collect protected-channel PCM, take a snapshot and clear the
capture buffer before processing.
Audio-quality gate
07 Require ≥1.5 seconds and voiced ratio ≥0.05. Retry inadequate
audio at most twice per phrase, then fail.
POST /embed
08 Send 16 kHz mono PCM to the internal ECAPA-TDNN service. Clear
the local snapshot after embedding.
Embedding; repeat ×3
09 Retain the vector for each usable phrase; repeat
prompting/capture until three embeddings exist. A scorer failure
fails enrollment.
Pairwise consistency ≥0.60
10 Use the worst pairwise cosine score, not an average that could
hide one outlier. Reject inconsistent recordings.
Encrypt + store template
11 Average embeddings; AES-GCM encrypt in VoiceprintStore and
persist consent/version/time and consistency metadata.
Enrolled / failed status
12 After a successful store, emit biometric audit, announce
completion and hang up. Status is owner-scoped.
Withdraw / delete profile
13 DELETE /api/voice-profile/me deletes the owner's template and
writes Deleted or DeleteFailed audit metadata.
IMPLEMENTATION NOTES
Enrollment checks usable audio and cross-sample consistency; it does not prove speaker liveness or verify exact spoken phrase text.
Verification voice mode defaults to observe. No profile, too little speech or unavailable scoring yields NotAssessed rather than an invented mismatch.
Source/configuration review · 20 September 2026 · not a live deployment audit · original Microsoft icons; see asset credits and source references in the companion guide.
